Bug_Title: "equals(Object obj)" should test the argument's type
Bug_Explanation: The equals(Object obj) method does not perform a type check before casting obj to MyClass. This results in a ClassCastException when the argument is not an instance of MyClass.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test case 'testEqualsMethodWithDifferentType' calls the'showBug' method on an instance of MyClass. This method tries to compare the instance with an Object of a different type, which causes a ClassCastException. This triggers the bug in the 'equals' method of MyClass, where the argument's type is not checked before casting.
